audience: inventory and operations teams who run stock and orders in Unleashed Software

useCases.title: Check stock on hand by product and warehouse
useCases.text: The AI reads quantity on hand, allocated and available, per product, for one warehouse or all, or as at a past date.

useCases.title: Review open sales orders for a customer
useCases.text: The AI lists sales orders by status, customer or date range and opens one with its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders placed with suppliers
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders by status, supplier or date range, and opens one with its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Check invoices, quotes and stock adjustments
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices and quotes by status, customer or date range, and stock adjustments (write-offs, recounts) by warehouse, product or date.

useCases.title: Add a customer, a product or a draft sales order
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer or a product, or a sales order in Parked status. A parked order reserves no stock and posts nothing to accounting.
